question.en:
A trader buys 187 pens at ₹23 each. During transportation, 7 pens get damaged and cannot be sold. He sells the remaining
 pens at ₹27 each. Find his profit percentage. (rounded off to one decimal place)
question.hi:
एक व्यापारी ₹23 प्रति पेन की दर से 187 पेन खरीदता है। परिवहन के दौरान, 7 पेन क्षतिग्रस्त हो जाते हैं और उन्हें बेचा नहीं जा सकता। वह शेष
 पेन ₹27 प्रति पेन की दर से बेचता है। उसका लाभ प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए। (अपना उत्‍तर दशमलव के एक स्थान तक पूर्णांकित करें)

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option C (**13.0%**).
solution.keyConcept: Pay CP on ALL 187 pens, earn SP ONLY on (187 − 7) = 180 sellable pens!

title.en: Method 1: Total CP vs Sellable SP
title.hi: विधि 1: कुल CP बनाम विक्रय योग्य SP

steps.en:
Total CP $= 187 \times 23 = 4301$. Sellable $= 187 - 7 = 180$ pens.
Total SP $= 180 \times 27 = 4860$. Profit $= 4860 - 4301 = 559$.
$\text{Profit}\% = \frac{559}{4301} \times 100 \approx \mathbf{13.0\%}$.
Ratio SP/CP $= \frac{180 \times 27}{187 \times 23}$. Numerator exceeds by `559`. Since `43 × 13 = 559`, `559 / 4301 ≈ 13 / 100` = **13.0%**!

solution.en:
Method 1: Total CP vs Sellable SP: Total CP $= 187 \times 23 = 4301$. Sellable $= 187 - 7 = 180$ pens.
Total SP $= 180 \times 27 = 4860$. Profit $= 4860 - 4301 = 559$.
$\text{Profit}\% = \frac{559}{4301} \times 100 \approx \mathbf{13.0\%}$.

Method 2: Clean Factor Shortcut (43 × 13 = 559) (4 sec): Ratio SP/CP $= \frac{180 \times 27}{187 \times 23}$. Numerator exceeds by `559`. Since `43 × 13 = 559`, `559 / 4301 ≈ 13 / 100` = **13.0%**!

A shopkeeper marks a product 75% above cost price and offers two successive discounts of 30% and 40%. What is the
 profit or loss percentage?
question.hi:
एक दुकानदार किसी उत्पाद पर क्रय मूल्य से 75% अधिक मूल्य अंकित करता है तथा 30% और 40% की दो क्रमिक छू ट प्रदान करता है।
 लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option C (**26.5% loss**).
solution.en:
Method 1: Base 100 Chain: $CP = 100 \implies MP = 175$.
$SP = 175 \times 0.70 \times 0.60 = 175 \times 0.42 = 73.5$.
Loss $= 100 - 73.5 = \mathbf{26.5\%\text{ loss}}$.

Method 2: Fraction Chain 7/4 × 7/10 × 3/5 (4 sec): $\frac{7}{4} \times \frac{7}{10} \times \frac{3}{5} = \frac{147}{200} = \frac{73.5}{100} \implies$ **26.5% loss**!
solution.hi:
विधि 1: CP = 100 श्रृंखला: $CP = 100 \implies MP = 175$।
$SP = 175 \times 0.7 \times 0.6 = 73.5 \implies$ हानि $= \mathbf{26.5\%}$।

विधि 2: भिन्न चेन 147/200 (4 sec): $\frac{7}{4} \times \frac{7}{10} \times \frac{3}{5} = \frac{147}{200} = 73.5\% \implies$ **26.5% हानि**!

solution.keyConcept: Negative × Negative = Positive + Division Precedes Subtraction!

optionTrick.en: Right denominator block `[5 × (2+1)] = 15`. Numerator `60×15 − (-8)×(-37) = 900 − 296`: just check **last 2 digits** `00 - 96 -> ...04`! Among options `[594, 614, 608, 604]/15`, **ONLY `604/15` ends in `04`**!

title.hi: विधि 1: चिह्न व कोष्ठक चरणबद्ध हल

solution.en:
Method 1: Careful Sign + Bracket Evaluation: 1) Left curly: $(-16 - 19 - 2) = -37$, so $(-8) \times (-37) = +296$.
2) Right square: $(-1)(-1) = +1 \Rightarrow \{2 + 1\} = 3 \Rightarrow [5 \times 3] = 15$.
3) Combine: $60 - 296 \div 15 = \frac{60 \times 15 - 296}{15} = \frac{900 - 296}{15} = \mathbf{\frac{604}{15}}$.

Method 2: `900 - 296` Last-Digit Speed Check (`8 sec`): Notice $8 \times 37$ ends in $6$ (`even!`), so $900 - (\dots 6)$ ends in **`4`** (`594` or `604`). Since $8 \times 37 \approx 300$, $900 - 296 = \mathbf{604}$ (`NOT 594`!) ⇒ **`604 / 15`**!

en: Ethernet in a LAN provides low-speed data transfer and connects users over public Internet infrastructure.

A trader marks an article 25% above its cost price. He allows a discount of 10% on the marked price. After giving the
 discount, he makes a profit of ₹180 on the article. What is the cost price of the article?
question.hi:
एक व्यापारी किसी वस्तु का मूल्य उसके क्रय मूल्य से 25% अधिक अंकित करता है। वह अंकित मूल्य पर 10% की छू ट प्रदान करता है। छू ट देने
 के बाद, उसे उस वस्तु पर ₹180 का लाभ प्राप्‍त होता है। वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य कितना था?

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option D (**₹1,440**).
solution.en:
Method 1: Net Percentage via CP = 100: $CP = 100 \implies MP = 125 \xrightarrow{-10\%\,(-12.5)} SP = 112.5$.
Profit `12.5% = 180` $\implies 100\% = 180 \times 8 =$ **₹1,440**.

Method 2: Oral 1/8 = ₹180 Multiplier (2 sec): Successive `+25%` & `-10%` $= +12.5\% = \frac{1}{8}$. Therefore `CP = 8 × Profit = 8 × 180` = **₹1,440**!

 force of 100 N. What is the difference in the work done by the two students?
